content.value: Suppose you have two different scenarios for 8254 as follows:

Scenario1: A programmer wants to check the count value and the status of a selected counter.   
Scenario2: A programmer wants to latch the count of a selected counter.
Now you as a programmer, in which scenario will you use which command mode? Justify your answer.
